title: Henchman's Backyard
wikitext:
The '''Henchman's Backyard''' is found in the [[Forbidden Maze]] behind the [[Henchman's House]], and becomes available after the [[Henchman]]'s 8 Heart Event. The area contains five shrines. There are three toggleable shrines similar to those in the Witch's Hut, and two shrines where materials can be traded for rare items. ==Shrines== {| class="wikitable" !Image !Name !Description !Offering |- |[[File:Dark Shrine of Invasion.png|Dark Shrine of Invasion.png]] |Dark Shrine of Invasion |Armies of monsters invade the valley at night....

''Note: This is only available after [[Krobus]]'s Ten Heart Event.'' |{{name|Void Shard}} |- |[[File:Dark Shrine of Moss.png|Dark Shrine of Moss.png]] |Dark Shrine of Moss |Removes and prevents moss from growing on all trees in the entire world. |{{name|Gold Carrot}} |- |[[File:Dark Shrine of Life.png|Dark Shrine of Life.png]] |Dark Shrine of Life |Offer 15 sludge in exchange for 1 life elixir. |{{name|Sludge}} (15) |- |[[File:Dark Shrine of Money.png|Dark Shrine of Money.png]] |Dark Shrine of Money |Offer 20 supernatural goo in exchange for 1 tree coin, which grows into a money tree. |{{name|Supernatural Goo}} (20) |} [[Category:Locations]]
